name: Cable Hip Adduction
steps: Stand sideways to a low pulley with its cuff on the ankle nearest the machine and balance on the other leg.
Draw the cuffed leg inward and slightly across the front of your standing leg.
Guide the leg back toward the pulley.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your trunk upright and your standing knee soft.
Move smoothly without letting the cable yank your leg back outward.
